nasaLunarEclipseObscuration.recipe: Pinned complete NASA SVS pages 4953 and 5672. Each directly publishes the Moon-disc area inside the umbra at greatest eclipse. Assuming nearest-0.1-percentage-point rounding, inclusive bounds add and subtract 0.0005 from the printed fraction without assuming a tie rule. Both pages come from one NASA SVS publisher and DE421/LOLA model family, and neither publishes its exact rounding rule, radii, or full-precision area algorithm. The inferred intervals are not NASA uncertainty bounds or a new accuracy policy.
nasaLunarEclipseObscuration.refraction: not applicable to geocentric eclipse geometry
nasaLunarEclipseObscuration.timeScale: the pages label greatest eclipse in Universal Time; the printed minute identifies the published event and is not asserted as an exact TT or UTC coordinate
nasaLunarEclipseObscuration.units: fraction of the Moon's disc area and Universal Time calendar labels
nasaLunarEclipseObscuration.version: NASA SVS 4953 released 2021-11-04; NASA SVS 5672 updated 2026-08-25

The official sofa_ast_example.c is pinned unchanged; sofa-fixed-star-reference.c generates fixed-star-reference.json against SOFA release 2023-10-11, including starpm propagation. The 0.5 arcsec static-row limit is twice the 0.246 arcsec sampled maximum rounded up, a regression margin rather than a published accuracy.

sofaFixedStar.units: sidereal hours, degrees, radians, milliarcseconds, kilometres per second, metres, Julian dates, parallax-derived light-years, and arcseconds
